pages.text: The Pulverizer grinds hard minerals into dust:$(li)Vanilla ores → matching dust$(li)Akaishi → Akaishi Dust$(li)$(2,4)Obsidian → Obsidian Dust$(0)$(br2)Dust is the key to heat sinks and high-tier crafting — the machine world's "grinder".
Obsidian Dust is one of its signature outputs.$(br)For the full dust list, head over to the "Dusts" entry.
